behavior: Two unsigned normalized 16-bit components: low L in storage B and high A in storage A; apply the native crossbar before exact UNORM16 RGBA upload. Native crossbar maps the two components to R/G and constant one to B/A.

tests.cpu: exact 16-bit lanes, padding, crossbar, six aligned cube faces
tests.GPU: independent two-channel bilinear sampling plus complete WebGPU regression

limitation: Shared executor uses RGBA16F storage for normalized 16-bit uploads. A fresh native 06 run is required; later IFC invalid-surface errors occurred after this missing-format trap and are not independently resolved by this change.
